CheckTitle: Ensure MFA is enabled for the 'root' user account
StatusExtended: Root account does not have MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) enabled.
Description: The root account is the most privileged user in an AWS account. MFA adds an extra layer of protection.
Risk: Compromise of the root account grants full administrative control over all resources in the AWS environment.

Recommendation.Text: Sign in to the AWS Management Console as root, go to IAM > Security Credentials, and enable virtual or hardware MFA.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets do not allow public read/write access
StatusExtended: S3 Bucket 'corp-finance-backup' has public read access granted via ACL and policy.
Description: Public S3 buckets allow unauthenticated internet users to view or download sensitive business data.
Risk: Data breach, accidental exposure of confidential financial records, intellectual property theft.

Recommendation.Text: Enable S3 Block Public Access on the bucket and restrict bucket ACL permissions to authorized identities.

Code.Terraform:
resource "aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block" "finance" {
  bucket = "corp-finance-backup"
  block_public_acls = true
  block_public_policy = true
  ignore_public_acls = true
  restrict_public_buckets = true
}

CheckTitle: Ensure no Security Groups allow ingress from 0.0.0.0/0 to port 22 (SSH)
StatusExtended: Security group 'launch-wizard-1' (sg-09a8b7c6) has port 22 open to 0.0.0.0/0.
Description: Security groups provide stateful filtering of ingress/egress network traffic to EC2 instances.
Risk: Exposure of port 22 increases risk of brute force attacks, credential spraying, and unauthorized server takeover.

Recommendation.Text: Restrict inbound SSH access to corporate VPN IP ranges or use AWS Systems Manager Session Manager instead of direct SSH.

CheckTitle: Ensure CloudTrail is enabled in all regions
StatusExtended: CloudTrail 'security-trail' is configured for us-east-1 only, missing activity in other active regions.
Description: CloudTrail records AWS API calls for your account and delivers log files to an Amazon S3 bucket.
Risk: Adversaries can perform unmonitored actions in unlogged regions, hindering forensics and threat detection.

Recommendation.Text: Update CloudTrail configuration to enable multi-region logging for all global services and regions.

CheckTitle: Ensure rotation for customer managed CMKs is enabled
StatusExtended: KMS Customer Master Key 'key-abc123' does not have automatic yearly rotation enabled.
Description: AWS KMS CMKs should have annual automatic key rotation enabled to limit the lifespan of encrypted data keys.
Risk: Failure to rotate keys expands the blast radius if cryptographic material is compromised.

Recommendation.Text: Enable automatic key rotation for the customer managed key in the KMS console or via AWS CLI.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets have Default Encryption enabled
StatusExtended: S3 Bucket 'app-assets' has default server-side encryption enabled (AES256).
Description: Amazon S3 default encryption ensures that all objects uploaded to the bucket are automatically encrypted at rest.
Risk: Data at rest in S3 without encryption may be exposed if storage media is compromised.

Recommendation.Text: Bucket is properly encrypted with AES-256.

CheckTitle: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
StatusExtended: IAM password policy requires minimum length of 16 characters.
Description: Password length policy enforces stronger user passwords resistant to dictionary attacks.
Risk: Short passwords are susceptible to cracking.

Recommendation.Text: Password policy meets and exceeds the recommended length requirement.

CheckTitle: Ensure RDS database instances have storage encryption enabled
StatusExtended: RDS Instance 'db-prod-primary' has storage encryption enabled using KMS key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/rds-key.
Description: Amazon RDS encrypted DB instances use industry-standard AES-256 encryption algorithm to encrypt your data.
Risk: Unencrypted database snapshots and volumes risk exposure.

Recommendation.Text: Database is properly encrypted with KMS.

CheckTitle: Ensure VPC flow logging is enabled in all VPCs
StatusExtended: VPC 'vpc-998877' (Production-VPC) does not have VPC Flow Logs enabled.
Description: VPC Flow Logs capture IP traffic information entering and leaving network interfaces in your VPC.
Risk: Without flow logs, security investigations and lateral movement detection are severely impaired.

Recommendation.Text: Create flow logs for the VPC to publish traffic data to CloudWatch Logs or an Amazon S3 bucket.

Code.CLI: aws ec2 create-flow-logs --resource-type VPC --resource-ids vpc-998877 --traffic-type ALL --log-destination-type s3 --log-destination arn:aws:s3:::corp-vpc-logs

CheckTitle: Ensure Amazon GuardDuty is enabled in all active regions
StatusExtended: Amazon GuardDuty is enabled in region us-east-1 (Detector ID: det-445566).
Description: GuardDuty is an intelligent threat detection service that continuously monitors malicious activity and unauthorized behavior.
Risk: Absence of threat detection enables undetected compromise.

Recommendation.Text: GuardDuty detector is properly configured and active.

CheckTitle: Ensure IAM roles do not allow wildcard '*' in trust relationship
Description: Wildcard principals in IAM role trust relationships allow any authenticated AWS entity across the entire AWS ecosystem to assume the role.
Risk: Total account takeover by external third parties with no trust boundary.

Recommendation.Text: Modify the trust policy of the role to restrict Principal to specific AWS Account IDs or ARNs.

CheckTitle: Ensure S3 Buckets have Object Versioning enabled
Description: Versioning in Amazon S3 is a means of keeping multiple variants of an object in the same bucket.
Risk: Accidental deletion or overwriting of files.
